name: moves-counted
find: | reduce $removed[] as $r ($added; (index([$r]) // null) as $k | if $k == null then . else del(.[$k]) end)

name: diff-failure-ignored
find: || { echo "invalid the changelog diff could not be read"; return 0; }

name: no-range-counted
find: [ -n "${MB:-}" ] && [ -n "${HEAD:-}" ] || { echo "invalid CHANGELOG_ADDED is unset and there is no MB..HEAD to count from"; return 0; }
